ui_bugs.issue: FIXED IN THIS RUN — useRef was used at line 92 but not imported, causing 'useRef is not defined' runtime crash on /booking page (helicopter/private_jet booking flow). This was a critical blocker preventing customers from booking helicopter/private jet after selecting service from Book Your Journey dropdown.

integration_issues.issue: refund-details-btn-{bookingId} was not rendered for the current customer's 3 visible trips even though /refunds/my returns refunds with details. Likely reason: refundMap keys off r.booking_id which may not match any current MyTrips trip.id (e.g. seeded refunds like YB2026080009 point to vertical_bookings but customer MyTrips shows different trips). Not reproducible with a live cancellable trip in this session. Backend /refunds/my details object shape is verified correct (12/12 pytest). Recommend the developer seed or preserve a completed-refund vertical_booking in customer's trips list so View Details is visible in-app, or confirm MyTrips is fetching vertical_bookings correctly and mapping by id.

action_items: Verify MyTrips RefundTracker 'View Details' visibility end-to-end by ensuring at least one refunded vertical booking appears in customer's trips list (currently the 3 visible trips do not have entries in refundMap keyed by booking_id). critical_code_review_comments: auction/AuctionDashboard.js line 92 used useRef without importing it — this is a Sev-1 that crashed the entire /booking (helicopter/private_jet) route. Fixed by adding useRef to the React import. Suggest an ESLint pre-commit check (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps + no-undef) to catch this class of defect early.

vertical_routes.py _check_asset_availability query filters start_date $lte end_date but does NOT filter on end_date $gte start_date; instead iterates in Python (L234-244) with a `be < start_date` skip. Works correctly for the tested cases but a proper $or overlap query at DB level would scale better and be more idiomatic.

vertical_routes.py update_asset allowed-fields set (L167-169) is duplicated conceptually with the create model — a shared 'ASSET_MUTABLE_FIELDS' constant would prevent drift when new booking-setup fields are added.

rca_of_the_issue: useRef bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/auction/AuctionDashboard.js used `const expiredRef = useRef(false);` at line 92 inside the CountdownBar component but the module-level React import at line 1 only imported `{ useState, useEffect, useCallback }`. When /booking (which imports AuctionDashboard chunk) rendered, React threw ReferenceError: useRef is not defined and the whole page fell back to the Uncaught Runtime Errors overlay, blocking helicopter/private_jet booking. Fix: added useRef to the React import.
